title: Chapter 1314
text:
PS: At the same time, I'd like to help Brother Moderator promote the event 'Super Godly Mechanic's 7th Book Review Section Event'. The event will last from today until the 28th of June. After this event, fifteen brothers will be randomly selected to give out armor leather titles.

'Super Godly Mechanic', take a day off.
